findings.one_line: The zero-coverage headline never identifies a specific published estimator/workflow as the refuted target (bibkey plus the guarantee it asserts); mentioning Gobillon--Magnac only as motivation is not the required theorem-level comparison.

The failure phase is conditional and may be empty, while the exact-oracle orthogonality class is not given as a perturbation-stable generic class or as an explicit nondegenerate observable-law witness with quantified failure; supply one (including reach) or narrow the claim. Subfield ceiling.

Positioning is otherwise focused, but several bibliography entries (including Onatski 2012, Freyaldenhoven 2022, Athey et al. 2021, Xu 2017, and Bai--Wang 2016) have no relevance sentence or theorem-level relation to the absorption law; complete or prune them.
